title: Second derivative of a C^2 function along a line
statement: Let E be a real normed space (E : Type with NormedAddCommGroup E and NormedSpace ℝ E) and F : E -> R of class C^2 (ContDiff ℝ 2 F). Then for all x, v in E, the real function g(t) = F(x + t v) satisfies deriv (deriv g) 0 = D^2F(x)[v][v], where D^2F(x)[v][v] = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x v v.
lean_statement: ∀ {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (F : E → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 F → ∀ x v : E, deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => F (x + t • v))) 0 = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x v v
